name: C2-1 Supervised Learning: fit a function from (x, y) pairs
description: Fit on 160 points, then score the 40 held back

data.noteContent:
The smallest honest supervised-learning loop: generate labelled points, hide a fifth of them, fit on the rest, and score on the part the model never saw.

After a run the accuracy Print reads 1.0 -- all 40 held-out points classified correctly. Two Gaussian blobs at this noise level really are separable by a straight line, so this is the easy case you confirm before trusting a harder one.

It runs instantly and downloads nothing. Raise the SyntheticDataset noise until the two blobs overlap, and watch the accuracy start to fall.

最小而誠實的監督式學習迴圈：先生出帶標籤的點，藏起五分之一，用剩下的擬合，再用模型沒看過的那一份評分。

跑完之後，準確率的 Print 會是 1.0 -- 保留的 40 個點全部分對。這種噪聲程度下的兩團高斯點本來就切得開，所以這是最簡單的情況，先確認它，再去相信更難的結果。

這張圖瞬間跑完，也不用下載任何東西。把 SyntheticDataset 的 noise 調大到兩團重疊，就會看到準確率開始往下掉。

test_size 0.2 puts 160 points in the training set and 40 in the test set; stratify keeps the class balance the same in both. The model is fitted on x_train and y_train, then asked about x_test, while y_test goes straight to Accuracy -- so the two never meet.

test_size 0.2 把 160 個點分到訓練集、40 個分到測試集；stratify 讓兩邊的類別比例一致。模型只用 x_train 和 y_train 擬合，再被問 x_test，而 y_test 直接送進 Accuracy -- 兩者從頭到尾不會碰面。
